collection.title: Toyota Alphard 2002 to 2008 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Toyota Alphard 2002 - 2008 requires a 26" wiper blade  the drivers side and a 16" wiper blade on the passengers side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
